description: Right hand: open (0-2 s); finger gun (index and thumb out, other fingers curled) held pointing up (2.4-5 s), then aimed left (5-7 s), right (7-9 s), up, down (11-13 s), toward the camera (about 13.5-19 s) and twisted (19-26 s); then gun, fist (27.5-29 s), gun (29.3-32 s), open hand (32-36 s); pointing with the thumb tucked in (36.6-40.3 s), which shouldn't engage a gun; an OK sign (41-44 s); a relaxed hand dropping. Pointed at the camera, the index's reach drops to 1.4-1.7 and its straightness in the image to 0.3-0.6. Recorded from a live webcam at 320x240 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data (every other frame, ~22 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them.
